title: Datum Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Datum data pinning tool

defaults.description: Default settings applied to all datasets

policy.description: Default policy for handling data changes

ignore.description: Whether fetched targets should be ignored by a detected Git or SVN working copy

source.description: Single data source (use either 'source' or 'sources', not both)

sources.description: Multiple data sources with automatic fallback (use either 'source' or 'sources', not both)

target.description: Local path where the data will be saved

policy.description: Override default policy for this dataset

ignore.description: Override whether this target should be ignored by a detected Git or SVN working copy

type.description: HTTP handler for fetching data from URLs

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch data from

body.description: Optional HTTP request body; a non-empty body uses POST instead of HEAD/GET

fileSource.description: Local or network file (or directory) source

type.description: File handler for copying local files or directories

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the source file or directory. If this is a directory (auto-detected at run time), the entire tree is recreated under 'target', and files deleted upstream are removed from 'target' on the next fetch.

gitSource.description: Git repository source (requires build with -tags git)

type.description: Git handler for fetching specific files from repositories

ref.description: Branch name or tag to fetch from (e.g., 'main', 'v1.0.0')

path.description: Path to the file within the repository

commandSource.description: Custom command source for executing shell commands

type.description: Command handler for executing shell commands

fingerprint_cmd.description: Shell command to compute the fingerprint (output used as fingerprint)

fetch_cmd.description: Shell command to fetch the data. Template variables: {{url}}, {{path}}, {{ref}}, {{dest}}. DEST env var also available.

url.description: Optional URL value for use in template variables {{url}}

path.description: Optional path value for use in template variables {{path}}

ref.description: Optional ref value for use in template variables {{ref}}
